content.text: At Zedgehost, we stand behind the quality of our web hosting services. If you are not completely satisfied with our performance, support, or features, we offer a refund policy subject to the terms below.
If you cancel your account within the first 30 days of purchase, you will receive a full refund of the hosting fees.

content.text: To request a refund, you must submit a cancellation request via the Zedgehost Client Area within the eligible time frame. Once the request is verified, the refund will be processed to your original payment method (e.g., Credit Card, PayPal, or local bank transfer) within 7-10 business days.
